name: 90008 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90008 (Los Angeles) has 191 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90008 (Los Angeles) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
